topic: FCI, FCI+, software comparison, and Tennessee STAR

facts.claim: The standard FCI schedule uses an initial adjacency search, collider orientation, Possible-D-SEP refinement, endpoint reset, and a final orientation phase.
facts.source_title: Causation, Prediction, and Search, second edition

facts.claim: The 2000 FCI result assumes Faithfulness and correct conditional-independence decisions, and the source leaves maximal informativeness of the original orientation schedule unresolved.
facts.source_title: Causation, Prediction, and Search, second edition, Chapter 6

facts.claim: Zhang's later orientation rules provide completeness for modern PAG representations under latent confounding and selection bias.
facts.source_title: On the completeness of orientation rules for causal discovery in the presence of latent confounders and selection bias

facts.claim: FCI+ uses augmented-skeleton, candidate D-SEP-link, and recursive hierarchy logic to replace standard FCI's broad Possible-D-SEP search.
facts.source_title: Learning Sparse Causal Models is not NP-hard

facts.claim: For fixed observed-MAG degree bound k, Faithfulness, and a constant-time exact conditional-independence oracle, FCI+ has worst-case query order O(N^(2(k+2))).
facts.source_title: Learning Sparse Causal Models is not NP-hard and proof supplement

facts.claim: Figure 4(b) of the FCI+ paper is a MAG example exhibiting separator {U,V,Z}, not a printed completed PAG.
facts.source_title: Learning Sparse Causal Models is not NP-hard

facts.claim: CRAN pcalg version 2.7-12 exposes standard FCI and fciPlus.
facts.source_title: CRAN pcalg package record and reference manual

facts.claim: The inspected causal-learn API documents standard FCI and named CI methods, but no public FCI+ entry point was identified.
Tetrad 7.6.10 documents standard FCI and distinct FCI-family algorithms; it was documentation-only in this project.
facts.source_title: CMU Tetrad official releases and source

facts.claim: The official Tennessee STAR data record contains 11,601 student records.
facts.source_title: Tennessee's Student Teacher Achievement Ratio (STAR) project
